basic_details.job_title: BRIC-THSTI Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 8 Project Assistant, Project Research Scientist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Walk-in interviews for BRIC-Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (BRIC-THSTI) project posts start on 19 November 2026 and run to 1 December 2026, with reporting at 9:00 am at THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad – 121001. Notice No. THS/RN/23/2026, dated 5 November 2026, covers 8 posts in 6 designations: Project Research Scientist-III, Project Research Scientist-II, Senior Technical Manager, Senior Technical Officer, Project Technical Support-III and Project Assistant. Monthly consolidated pay runs from Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 1

content_sections.heading: About BRIC-THSTI
content_sections.text: BRIC-Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI) is an institute of the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council, Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India. It is part of the interdisciplinary NCR Biotech Science Cluster at Faridabad. Its stated mission is to conduct innovative translational research and build research collaborations across disciplines to turn concepts into products that improve human health.

content_sections.heading: BRIC-THSTI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Data analysis and scientific writing. Train junior researchers and involve in multidisciplinary research. Preparation of recombinant plasmids. Culturing and performing experiments with Mycobacterium tuberculosis strains in the BSL3 laboratory. Setting up biochemical, immunological and cell-based assays and analysis. Work on a drug discovery project as a medicinal chemist. Design and synthesize novel molecules in the lab for biological screening, then evaluate some of them for drug metabolism and pharmacokinetic studies using in vitro and in vivo assays. Work closely with the bioanalytical team on method development and validation of the selected molecules to support DMPK work. Hands-on experience in assay validation and implementation of quality control and quality assurance processes to achieve and maintain laboratory accreditation. Sound knowledge of regulatory requirements and processes applicable to assays used in diagnostics and vaccine development. Experience in preparing technical reports, budgets and presentations, and in managing international projects, will be preferred. The notice prints no duties for this post. Its skills column lists experience in ISO standards relevant for calibration and testing labs, preparation of SOPs and QSPs, and proficiency in MS-Office. Plan and execute experimental work, perform molecular and immunological assays, including mouse experiments. Responsible for data recording, analysis, figure preparation, and assistance in manuscript writing and reporting. Responsible for maintaining records, writing reports and procurement related to laboratory requirements. Increased responsibility in later years will include coordination of experimental workflows as per the needs and progress of the project. Discuss the experimental plan and report the results regularly to the PI, and train the junior members of the laboratory. Regular maintenance of the inventory and the documents needed by the funding agency. Must comply with laboratory rules and be ready to take on any additional responsibilities needed for the project. Preference will be given to candidates with demonstrated experience in cellular and immunological studies. faq.question: Q1. When is the BRIC-THSTI walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in dates depend on the post: 19 November 2026 for Project Technical Support-III (JEV project), 20 November 2026 for Project Research Scientist-II (both posts) and Project Assistant, 30 November 2026 for Project Research Scientist-III and Project Technical Support-III (plasma-proteins project), and 1 December 2026 for Senior Technical Manager and Senior Technical Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Candidates report at 9:00 am at THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad – 121001. Latecomers beyond the time slot will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in BRIC-THSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 posts, one each in 8 entries, covering 6 designations. The notice says the number of vacancies may change with the actual requirement at the time of the test or interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Assistant?
faq.answer: A B.Sc. degree in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognised university. The incumbent should know buffer and cell culture media preparation, bacterial cell culture and molecular techniques such as gel electrophoresis, Western blotting and PCR/qPCR.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: It is 45 years for Project Research Scientist-III and Senior Technical Manager, 40 years for both Project Research Scientist-II posts and Senior Technical Officer, 35 years for Project Technical Support-III and 50 years for Project Assistant. Age is counted on the date of interview of the post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Monthly consolidated emoluments are Rs. 78,000 plus HRA (Project Research Scientist-III), Rs. 67,000 plus HRA (Project Research Scientist-II), Rs. 1,40,000 (Senior Technical Manager), Rs. 91,000 (Senior Technical Officer), Rs. 28,000 plus HRA (Project Technical Support-III) and Rs. 20,000 plus HRA (Project Assistant).

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: For the Project Research Scientist, Project Technical Support-III and Project Assistant posts, the notice prints "plus HRA" with the pay. For Senior Technical Manager and Senior Technical Officer, the pay is printed as Rs. 1,40,000/- and Rs. 91,000/- without mention of HRA.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring your latest CV/resume, one set of photocopies of educational qualification and experience documents with the originals, and a valid ID card. Mobile phones must be deposited at reception with valid identity proof.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates walk in for a written test, skill test or interview at 9:00 am on the date of their post. If many candidates appear, screening limits the number to those with higher or relevant qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No, these are short-term positions. Extension is subject to satisfactory performance and the tenure of the project, and appointees have no claim for regularization of employment.
